verdict.rationale: Docs and quickstart show strong first-party SDK support for Python and TypeScript/JS (e.g. table.search(...).toArray() in TS, Python examples throughout, Rust embedding API), and a community comment confirms an npm package for JS/TS. However, there is no evidence anywhere in the pack of official Go or Java SDKs. Missing for 10: Go SDK documentation/examples, Java SDK documentation/examples, and independent confirmation of parity across all four languages.
